description: This file provides service functions for managing budget data, including listing, creating, updating, deleting budgets, and computing utilization. It handles schema variations for 'limit' and 'budget_limit' columns in the 'budgets' table.

methods.name: budgetsUsesBudgetLimit
methods.description: Detects if the 'budgets' table has a 'budget_limit' column by attempting a lightweight select query.

methods.name: normalizeBudgetRow
methods.description: Normalizes a budget database row to a consistent object with 'limit' property, handling schema variations.

methods.name: listBudgets
methods.description: Lists budgets for a user, optionally filtered by month, handling different schema versions.

methods.name: mapLimitForWrite
methods.description: Prepares payload for insert/update by mapping 'limit' to either 'budget_limit' or 'limit' based on schema.

methods.name: createBudget
methods.description: Creates a new budget record in the database, normalizing the response.

methods.name: updateBudget
methods.description: Updates an existing budget record identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteBudget
methods.description: Deletes a budget record by ID.

methods.name: computeUtilization
methods.description: Calculates total spent and utilization per budget for a user and month.
